classification_definitions.approved-for-publication: An affirmative public reuse basis has been verified for this exact artifact and intended use.
classification_definitions.external-reference: Link to the provider's ordinary landing or reader page; do not mirror the artifact.
classification_definitions.private-reference: Retain in controlled research storage and use only within the recorded comparison scope.
classification_definitions.permission-required: Do not publish until appropriate permission or a compatible license is documented.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Provenance or public eligibility is incomplete; promotion fails closed.
classification_definitions.prohibited: The intended use is known to be incompatible with the applicable terms or project policy.

artifacts.title: Ibn Hajar's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah
artifacts.rights_basis: The medieval author's underlying work is public domain; this classification does not extend to any modern edition, transcription, translation, annotation, or scan.
allowed_actions: create an independently sourced scholarly edition
create a new English translation from an approved Arabic base
prohibited_public_actions: treat a modern edition or digital transcription as covered by the underlying-work classification

artifacts.title: Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah 1995 Arabic edition
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying medieval work is public domain, but the modern introduction, critical apparatus, annotations, and sufficiently original editorial revisions are not approved for redistribution by Sabiqah.
allowed_actions: external link to provider landing or reader pages
prohibited_public_actions: mirror scans or OCR
publish modern introduction, notes, indexes, or critical apparatus
represent stripped or reformatted DKI text as an independently reusable edition

artifacts.title: Usul/Shamela reader text for the DKI 1995 edition
artifacts.rights_basis: Usul's availability and Shamela provenance do not establish Sabiqah's redistribution rights; the reader includes modern editorial material from the DKI edition.
prohibited_public_actions: republish reader text
use the provider's conduct as a rights basis

artifacts.title: Modern Urdu translation witness
artifacts.rights_basis: The edition identifies Maktaba Rahmaniya as reserving publication rights, and no compatible reuse license has been verified.
allowed_actions: external link to provider landing page
prohibited_public_actions: mirror scans, OCR, or structured units
use as the public English translation base
copy protected Urdu expression into public notes or translations

artifacts.title: OpenITI cleaned al-Isabah text, JK000533
artifacts.rights_basis: OpenITI distributes the pinned transcription under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and documents removal of modern paratext. It is approved for Sabiqah's attributed, noncommercial, share-alike public working edition; this does not make it the canonical Al-Isabah edition.
allowed_actions: attributed noncommercial public display under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
machine alignment and translation under the same license conditions
external reference and comparison subject to the provider's license
prohibited_public_actions: claim independent provenance by copying the corpus
omit attribution, apply incompatible terms, or use outside the noncommercial license scope
represent machine alignment as canonical scholarly approval

artifacts.title: 1905-1907 Arabic Collections Online edition
artifacts.rights_basis: Arabic Collections Online states that it believes the displayed materials are in the public domain. The four 1905-1907 volumes have been identified and integrity-bound as an independent visual witness; their pagination is not represented as matching the OpenITI edition.
allowed_actions: public visual reference with source attribution
prohibited_public_actions: claim page identity with the OpenITI source edition
copy modern third-party metadata or annotations without a separate basis

artifacts.title: Sabiqah Al-Isabah public working corpus v1
artifacts.rights_basis: Displayed Arabic is deterministically rebuilt from the pinned CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 OpenITI authority. Sabiqah-authored English is retained only after private Arabic, locators, apparatus, editorial notes, and translated honorific forms are excluded. Records that fail a gate are quarantined rather than served.
allowed_actions: anonymous public reading with attribution and license notice
prohibited_public_actions: serve quarantined records or private comparison evidence
describe unreviewed records as canonical or human-approved
promote records without the independent repository review gates

artifacts.title: Volume 8 aligned Arabic source
artifacts.rights_basis: Derived from the DKI 1995 Usul reader/facsimile and includes editorial apparatus; not independently reconstructed from an approved reusable base.
prohibited_public_actions: publish as canonical Arabic
promote into a public book release

artifacts.title: Volume 8 structured English translation
artifacts.rights_basis: The English was generated from the blocked DKI-derived Arabic and consulted the private Urdu witness. Independent source-boundary review and human scholarly review are incomplete.
prohibited_public_actions: publish or promote before source-boundary and human review
describe machine validation as publication approval

artifacts.title: Volume 8 candidate entry records
artifacts.rights_basis: The projection embeds the blocked Arabic and unresolved English; structural validity does not establish public eligibility.
prohibited_public_actions: publish as a canonical release
serve through Sabiqah as approved content

artifacts.title: Khadijah and immediate-associates cohort
artifacts.rights_basis: The cohort uses the same DKI/Usul Arabic authority, embeds modern apparatus, and has incomplete source-boundary and human review.
prohibited_public_actions: publish or promote as canonical content
hydrate private evidence into public infrastructure
